name: Tuggs' Grub Sienar-Chall Utilipede Transport
description: Tuggs' Grub Sienar-Chall Utilipede Transport was a modified Sienar-Chall Utilipede Transport converted by chef Strono Tuggs into a mobile kitchen for his traveling diner, Tuggs' Grub. Following the destruction of Takodana Castle, Tuggs docked the ship at Docking Bay 7 Food and Cargo in Black Spire Outpost on Batuu.

data.name: Tuggs' Grub Sienar-Chall Utilipede Transport
role: Preservation of foodstuffs and live cargo
